{{- /* creator/stream.html — time stream for daily-note style folders (arch/26 §2.5). Input: (dict "page" . "node" ). Date desc. Full body for the latest 30, titles only after that. Side rail: latest 20 + year/month archive. Date: frontmatter date (via .Date) when present; else YYYY-MM-DD from the file name; else .Date. */ -}} {{- $page := .page -}} {{- $f := .node -}} {{- $_ := partial "creator/nodes.html" $page -}}{{- $nodes := $page.Scratch.Get "creatorNodes" -}} {{- $subVariant := cond (eq $page.Kind "section") "compact" "full" -}} {{- $prefix := printf "%s/" $f.slug -}} {{- $items := slice -}} {{- range $nodes -}} {{- if and (eq .g 1) (strings.HasPrefix .slug $prefix) -}} {{- $d := .date -}}{{- $dt := .dateText -}} {{- if and (not .hasDate) .fdate -}}{{- $d = .fdate -}}{{- $dt = .fdateText -}}{{- end -}} {{- $items = $items | append (merge . (dict "sdate" $d "sdateText" $dt "ym" (substr $d 0 7) "y" (substr $d 0 4))) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $items = sort $items "sdate" "desc" -}}
{{- partial "creator/folder-head.html" (dict "page" $page "node" $f "nodes" $nodes) -}}
{{- range $i, $it := $items -}} {{- $label := $it.title -}}{{- if not $it.hasTitle -}}{{- $label = $it.sdateText -}}{{- end -}}
{{- partial "creator/icon.html" (dict "name" "calendar-days" "size" 14) -}} {{- partial "creator/dates.html" (dict "iso" $it.sdate "text" $it.sdateText "rel" false) -}} {{- with $it.tags -}}
    {{ range . }}
  • {{ . }}
    • {{ end }}
{{- end -}}

{{ $label }}

{{- if lt $i 30 -}} {{- /* `where .Site.RegularPages "RelPermalink"` never matches in Foundry → GetPage by slug. */ -}} {{- with $page.Site.GetPage $it.slug -}}
{{ .WikilinkContent }}
{{- end -}} {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}

{{ i18n "creator.recent" }}

    {{- range first 20 $items -}} {{- $label := .title -}}{{- if not .hasTitle -}}{{- $label = .sdateText -}}{{- end -}}
  • {{ $label }}
    • {{- end -}}

{{ i18n "creator.archive" }}

{{- $years := slice -}}{{- $ys := dict -}} {{- range $items -}}{{- if and .y (not (index $ys .y)) -}}{{- $ys = merge $ys (dict .y true) -}}{{- $years = $years | append .y -}}{{- end -}}{{- end -}} {{- $years = sort $years "value" "desc" -}} {{- range $yi, $y := $years -}}
{{ $y }} {{- $months := slice -}}{{- $ms := dict -}} {{- range $items -}}{{- if and (eq .y $y) (not (index $ms .ym)) -}}{{- $ms = merge $ms (dict .ym true) -}}{{- $months = $months | append .ym -}}{{- end -}}{{- end -}} {{- $months = sort $months "value" "desc" -}} {{- range $ym := $months -}} {{- $inMonth := where $items "ym" $ym -}}
{{ time.Format "January" (time.AsTime (printf "%s-01" $ym)) }} {{ len $inMonth }}
    {{- range $inMonth -}} {{- $label := .title -}}{{- if not .hasTitle -}}{{- $label = .sdateText -}}{{- end -}}
  • {{ $label }}
    • {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
